==Background==
{{Quote|Just like how a tiny nut once seemed to shine,<br>
or how a little flower by the roadside once gave us dreams,<br>
we used to call those small, everyday moments of joy our “TREASURES.”<br>
How many such treasures might be hidden in the vast garden of life?<br>
I hope you’ll enjoy exploring this “TREASURE GARDEN” together with Chao and Hatsune Miku!|Author's comment}}
"'''TREASURE GARDEN'''" is an original song by Ponchi♪ featuring Hatsune Miku. It is the fourth of five songs in the Project ONSOKU series, a collaboration project between Hatsune Miku and the racing game ''{{IW|sonic|Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds}}''.

<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
Once upon a time, on a wondrous day I saw...
1, 2, 3, 4

Picked up a shiny little nut,
slipped it in my sandy pocket.
When a pretty flower blooms,
will the whole world smile along with me?

My heart is bubbling with excitement!
My body's itching, can't sit still!
Hey, little fairy over there,
come with me — I need you!

It's not fun being all alone!
When we're together, nothing's scary!
(Dont' stop!! Yeah!!)
Once we start running, there's not stopping!
Let's all go together!

Shall we sing out a great big love right here?
Something that makes even the sun grin wide!
Shall we plant a bunch of seeds right there?
Then surely, we'll all be HAPPY!
then surely, everyone's HAPPY!

How do you want to live your life?
Do you still have things you truly love?
Don't just keep marking X's through them,
don't take them for granted!

How do you want to live your life?
Do you still have a dream you hold inside?
Save it, keep it safe, SAVE SAVE it,
and stubbornly, ROCK ON!!

What kind of grown-up will we become?
Let's bloom a rainbow of flowers, one for each of us.

Isn't there a great big love right here?
Something that makes even the sun smile bright!
Shall we pour in plenty of water there?
Then surely, we'll all be HAPPY!

Shall we sing out a great big love right here?

When this place overflows with love,
then surely, it'll be beautiful!
Then surely, everyone's HAPPY!

With you, La La La
feeling High High High!
Let's Dance, Dance, Dance,
I just wanna keep on smiling here!

With you, La La La
feeling High High High!
Let's Dance, Dance, Dance,
I just wanna keep on smiling now!

I just wanna smile with everyone all around the world!
</poem>

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured on the following albums:
* ''トレジャーガーデン (Treasure Garden)''
* ''Smilin’''

===Video games===
This song was featured in the following video games:
* ''{{IW|sonic|Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds}}''
* ''{{IW|chunithm||CHUNITHM X-VERSE}}''
* ''{{IW|maimai||maimai Deluxe CiRCLE}}''
* ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''
* ''{{IW|initiald|Initial D The Arcade}}'' (Project ONSOKU Collaboration)
* ''{{IW|ongeki||O.N.G.E.K.I. Re:Fresh}}''
